commitments.detail: Ensure all operators are certified before operation.
Verify barcodes on the first 100 cases produced by the palletizer.
Ensure all operators are certified before operation.
An exclusion zone of 1.5 meters will be established around the palletizer during operation.
Two certified operators will be assigned to ensure proper use of the palletizer.
All operators will be certified before operation.
